name: OPet
author: Chiefiverse
description: Bar entry for the OPet desktop pet: start, stop, pause and pull without leaving the bar.

barWidget.description: Supervises the pet's layer-shell process and talks to it over its control socket.

schema.label: opet executable
schema.description: Absolute path to the opet binary. Required - nothing is guessed.

schema.label: Body manifest (pet.json)
schema.description: The pet to start. Required - the overlay refuses to run without it.

schema.label: Pet library directory ($OPET_PETS)
schema.description: Needed for the collection book to list more than the one body above.

schema.label: Accessory library directory ($OPET_ACCESSORIES)
schema.description: The wardrobe reads accessories from here.

schema.label: Save file (--db)
schema.description: Empty = demo mode: nothing is written to disk and the card shows DRYRUN.

schema.label: Bar height in logical pixels (0 = measure)
schema.description: 0 asks Hyprland for the reserved top edge before every start. Set it only to override.

schema.label: Start the pet when the shell loads
schema.description: The pet lives under the shell's supervision, so restarting the shell restarts it.
